info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Carrental Reservations Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Car Rental Reservation API allows users to effectively cancel existing car rental reservations. By targeting specific reservations with their unique identifiers, this API streamlines the cancellation process, improving customer service and operational efficiency. This functionality is particularly useful for travel agencies and customers looking to manage their bookings dynamically. The API ensures that resources are freed up promptly, enhancing overall fleet management and customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing reservation. Ensure that the reservation ID is valid and the reservation is eligible for cancellation.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a reservation. This should include the relevant details needed to identify and process the cancellation request.

200.description: The cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a reservation operation in JSON format.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.title: Cancel Reservation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the reservation.

resultId.description: ID associated with the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the reservation after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message regarding the cancellation process.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation process.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.description: Schema representing the response returned when a reservation cancellation is successfully processed.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Email or identifier of the user who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the cancellation was performed by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing information about the user and time associated with the cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, in milliseconds. This value helps in assessing the performance of the DELETE operation.
